summary: This chunk adds a new file, benchmark.json, recording eval results for the adversarial-review-2 skill. It ran 2 evals (each with 9 expectation checks) in two configurations: with_skill and without_skill, one run each. with_skill scored 1.0 pass rate on both evals (9/9); without_skill scored 0.67 (6/9) on both, failing on strict rank ordering, an explicit ranked-harm charter, and a bottom-line verdict with prioritized minimum-changes list. with_skill took much longer (94.8-118.0s vs 17.1-28.7s) and used more tokens (~58.8k-66.7k vs ~34.0k-38.1k). A run_summary aggregates means/stddev/min/max per configuration plus deltas (+0.33 pass rate, +83.5s, +26765 tokens).

The delta block reports deltas (+0.33, +83.5, +26765) as flat numbers with only 1 run per configuration per eval feeding the means, so stddev of 0.0 for pass_rate reflects identical results across the 2 evals rather than genuine run-to-run variance testing; no confidence interval or significance note accompanies the delta.
